Ideally wetted vs fully flooded: CO₂ during the potential sweep

The two 2D base cases side by side (top: ideally wetted catalyst layer, bottom: fully flooded), both with electrolyte-channel reactions on. Drag the slider to move both along the potential sweep and compare dissolved CO₂ in the electrolyte channel and catalyst layer and the CO₂ mole fraction on the gas side.

Frames come from the two General Form COMSOL base-case models (log concentrations), computed every 0.05 V from −1.0 to −2.5 V vs SHE. Between computed points the view crossfades the two neighbouring solutions and interpolates the readouts; only the computed points are model solutions. Panels have separate x scales (the catalyst layer is 3.8 µm thick). Dotted lines mark the electrode ends; grey is outside a layer. Arrow keys move the slider.
